additional_info.subject: ID0483165 - ID0483165-DC/Si-D/AT-[Multi] Error V2G - Message Timeout CRM:03097000499
additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your request and after our check, as you can see in the attached screenshot:
When you have these log, you should always look for the
“Final”
part. In this case, you can see
“CableCheck.”
This means the process failed during the
CableCheck
step. You may also notice transitions such as
P02 → P00
or
P03 → P00
.
As shown in the screenshot logs, it fails at
P02 → EV fault
, which means the issue is related to the
EV side
.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Please provide us with feedback so we can close this ticket.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
